plan.failureSummary: Cached page.ai selector for the Developers dropdown targeted the wrong navigation index (Solutions), navigating to an unintended solutions page and failing the expected /docs/ URL assertion.
observedIndicators: The deterministic cache contains a structural CSS selector (#nav > ... > div:nth-of-type(2) > button) intended for the Developers dropdown, but it matched the 'Solutions' button on the live page.
Donobu tool execution history shows left-clicking and hovering on the 'Solutions' button instead of 'Developers'.
The page navigated to 'https://www.checklyhq.com/solutions/use-cases/critical-user-flows/' instead of 'https://www.checklyhq.com/docs/', causing the URL assertion to fail.
Historical runs demonstrate prior self-heal successes when regenerating the cache after deterministic replay failures.

remediationSteps.summary: Clear cached page.ai instructions and rerun autonomously
remediationSteps.details: Clear the Page.AI cache for checkly.test.ts and re-execute the test so page.ai autonomously discovers the current 'Developers' dropdown and 'Documentation' links.

plan.notes: The test instruction is unambiguous and valid. Resetting the Page.AI cache allows autonomous planning to target the correct navigation element.
